title: Level ! (Run For Your Life) and Level Fun
note: Shots carry a run- or fun- prefix: review/b14/sbs holds copies of review/baseline/run and /fun (reshot in B14 on a build of unchanged main; the B0 sets are kept as run-b0 and fun-b0) and of the final after shots. B14 re-spotted Level !'s black wide-07, prop-1 and prop-2 under EXIT signs and added close spots for the bed, the start room's door wall, a notice, the dispenser, the crash rail, an EXIT sign, a wheelchair, an IV stand and a gurney; on Level Fun for the elevator doors, the lobby's party dressing and floor, the ceiling balloons, the poster, the directory, the palm and a speaker. Level ! is lit red by design.
